Vessels of preserved organic matter have begun to appear in deep space, concealed within the nooks and shadows of derelict hulks and infested space outposts. These haunted mementos have attracted a number of enigmatic traders from all corners of the universe, all set upon gathering the samples for their collections.

Fortunately, these strange opportunists are only too pleased to lean on the expertise of experienced Travellers and whoever has mastered the skills of salvaging such in-demand materials. Any brave courier willing to venture into these ominous treasure troves and salvage their curious bounty can barter with forsaken traders, exchanging mementos for unique, sinisterly biomechanical corvette modules. Spook up your existing corvette exterior, or lean fully into the creepy vibe and build a whole new scarecraft.

description:
Inspired by arcade beat ’em ups of the late ’80s and early ’90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action. Huge sprites and animated backgrounds breathe life into the dying city streets, while fighting mechanics offer uncommon depth with destructive combos, counters, air-throws, grappling, parries, special moves and “RIOT” supers! Animated cutscenes and a powerful soundtrack by famed composer Daniel Lindholm set the tone for urban mayhem, playable solo or with friends in local co-op!

Fallen City Brawl is out now for PS5® and PS4®.
